query: Let `u, b, c : ℕ → ℝ` with `0 ≤ u n₀`, `0 ≤ b n`, `0 ≤ c n` for all `n ≥ n₀`, and assume the recurrence inequality `u (n+1) ≤ (1 + c n) · u n + b n` for `n ≥ n₀`. Then for every `n ≥ n₀`, `u n ≤ (u n₀ + ∑_{k = n₀}^{n−1} b k) · exp (∑_{i = n₀}^{n−1} c i)`.
